# Dependencies and Supply-Chain Management Prompt

Apply after [base.md](base.md).

Inventory origin, revision, integrity, owner, license, update channel, scripts, binaries, packages, hooks, network access, tools, permissions, symlinks, and transitive dependencies. Record credential requirements without values.

Quarantine suspicious or unverifiable content before activation. Route broken or unsafe analysis to doctor. Require staged validation and rollback for updates.

Do not execute managed scripts merely to inspect them or silently trust a popular source.
